#      pip install torch==2.5.1 torchvision==0.20.1 torchaudio==2.5.1 \

# 2. Install everything below:
#      pip install -r requirements.txt
# 3. Install FastChat and human-eval from source (see README) for the
#    conversation templates / MT-Bench loading and the HumanEval benchmark.
